{{Quote|Mind the lesson of Vuras. Revenge, this Jedi sought. Employed the tactics of his enemy, he did. Defeated them, he did. But destroyed himself also, yes.|Yoda, to Ki-Adi Mundi|<ref name="PtR 0" />}}
'''Vuras''' was a [[Jedi/Legends|Jedi]] of the [[Jedi Order/Legends|Jedi Order]].<ref name="PtR 0" /> At some point by [[33 BBY/Legends|33 BBY]],<ref name="Date">''[[The New Essential Chronology]]'' dates the start of ''[[Star Wars: Republic]]'' to [[33 BBY/Legends|33 BBY]]. As [[Prelude to Rebellion 0|''Prelude to Rebellion'' 0]] is the series' preview issue, its mention of Vuras must have been by that [[Standard year/Legends|year]].</ref> Vuras adopted his enemy's tactics to exact revenge against them. However, Vuras' efforts in defeating his foes destroyed him. [[Jedi Master/Legends|Jedi Master]] [[Yoda/Legends|Yoda]] later cited Vuras' example during a training session with the [[Cerean/Legends|Cerean]] [[Padawan/Legends|Padawan]] [[Ki-Adi-Mundi/Legends|Ki-Adi-Mundi]].<ref name="PtR 0" />

==Behind the scenes==
Vuras was mentioned in [[Prelude to Rebellion 0|''Prelude to Rebellion'' 0]], a preview comic for [[Dark Horse Comics]]' ''[[Star Wars: Republic]]'' [[Star Wars comic books|comic-book]] series. The issue was written by [[Peet Janes]] and released on [[StarWars.com]]<ref name="PtR 0" /> on [[July 12]], [[1998]].<ref name="TFN">{{WebCite|url=https://www.theforce.net/latestnews/story/Prelude_to_Rebellion_0_Now_Online_82225.asp|text=Prelude to Rebellion #0 Now Online|date=1998-07-12|archivedate=20100620074632}}</ref>
